precedingFailures.reason: A highest-priority sanitized trace exposed PUT m.direct returning 403 after successful join. The gateway now reads its existing HRIS-derived map and confirms only the identical normalized value; arbitrary account-data remains denied.

attempts.reason: Nested test fixture needed an inner instance for its test helper.
Jackson JsonNode.map shadows the Kotlin collection extension; use iterator/asSequence explicitly.

precedingFailures.reason: The foreign room was correctly rejected with 404. The owned join received 503 collaboration_provider_busy; the fixture now makes at most four explicit attempts with bounded delay. Product repositories still make each join once and never implicitly re-enroll.
Platform has formatCheck and architectureCheck, not Mobile detekt. Corrected task selection before actual fixture execution.

The store proof restored a replacement local session but its entry helper retained the previous owner. RuntimeNotOpen correctly rejected the lookup before SDK join. An initial room-ID syntax hypothesis did not fix it. Controlled diagnostics identified the stale owner; the fixture now updates its current owner after successful restoration.
Focused Gradle command omitted ANDROID_HOME; corrected environment passed.

notes: The gateway confirms m.direct only when it equals the current HRIS DIRECT scope; wrong subjects, malformed requests, attempted scope changes and late permission loss are rejected.
Known SDK and server denials survive post-request scope reads and late cleanup, including failed cleanup.
One active raw sync request per connection; at most five transient retries, bounded exponential backoff, retained SDK cursor and no automatic business-command replay.
Stop retains the native operation and exclusive store lock until completion; a cancelled close waiter cannot unlock early.
The deterministic 429 is injected only after actual process death/restoration; successful same-cursor retry and both encrypted directions are required.
Owned projections, history windows, bootstrap recovery, logical reconciliation and product chat UI remain pending. No product group is accepted.
